description: Port of typescript-eslint's `member-ordering` rule (https://typescript-eslint.io/rules/member-ordering) with its default options: a member is flagged when an earlier member of the same body belongs to a group ranked later in the default member-type order.

violation.message: Member should be declared before all definitions of a group that precedes it in the configured order.
